properties.site-address: Fawkham Business Park, Fawkham Road, Fawkham
properties.notes: The site is not connected to a settlement but is within walking distance of Longfield which has good transport links. The existing access onto Fawkham Road could be utilised. Overall the site is considered able to accommodate development, subject to the retention or reprovision of the employment floorspace, however it is located within the Green Belt so this designation would need to change in order for it to be developed.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
